annotations.title: Search all of a company's annual reports

description: Everything one company has said about a subject across every annual report it has on EDGAR, back to the 1990s where they exist: the best passages with links, how often it came up each year, and optionally how that moved with a margin, tested against chance. Reads the reports on this machine; no key. Supply the company's likely words in also and all_of, since a company rarely uses yours.

all_of.description: What counts as a mention: a paragraph must hold at least one term from every group, such as [["supply chain","supplier"],["Southeast Asia","Vietnam","Thailand"]]. Without it, a paragraph counts if it holds most of the query's words.

also.description: Other words a company might use for the same subject, which you supply, such as contract manufacturer, Vietnam, Thailand. They help the ranking.

correlate_with.description: Compare how often the subject comes up with this measure, year by year, from the company's XBRL (2009 on).

filed_before.description: Only reports filed by this date.

per_year.description: Most passages from one report; default 2.

query.description: The subject in plain words, for example "supply chain problems in Southeast Asia". Quote a phrase to keep its words together.

section.description: Only one part of each report: "risk factors", "md&a", "business" or an item number such as 1A.

semantic.description: Also rank by meaning with a local embedding model, if one is installed (canli-mcp models install). Helps when a company's words differ from yours and you have supplied no others. The first run over a company's reports takes minutes; later ones are quick.

years.description: How many annual reports back; default 20. The hosted server reads at most 10.

name: filing_memory

outputSchema.description: rows are one report each, newest first; passages hold what was said, with links.

title: Search all of a company's annual reports
